items.name: Expand
items.signature: func Expand(alg string, prk []byte, info []byte, n int) []byte!
items.doc: Expand derives n bytes from prk and info (n at most 255 times the hash length).

items.doc: Extract returns the HKDF pseudorandom key of ikm (RFC 5869; an empty salt is HashLen zeros).
